name: Dhruv Kanwar
tagline: React frontends + Laravel backends + AI-powered automation for brands that mean business.
bio: I'm Dhruv — a full stack developer who builds premium business websites that don't just look expensive, they perform. I pair pixel-obsessed React frontends with rock-solid Laravel backends.
For the past six years I've helped startups, local businesses and growing brands turn visitors into paying customers with fast, accessible, conversion-focused websites.
My sweet spot is the full journey: strategy, interface design, front-of-house React, and the API/admin layer in Laravel + MySQL that keeps everything running.
I also build AI-powered products — like an LLM-driven AI receptionist that handles calls, extracts intent and generates work orders in real time — bringing automation into the same stack.

principles.title: Conversion first
principles.text: Every layout decision is measured against one question: does this help the visitor say yes?

principles.title: Craft obsessed
principles.text: Micro-interactions, motion and typography treated with the same rigor as the architecture.

principles.title: Built to scale
principles.text: Clean, documented code and an API-ready architecture so the product grows with the business.
